name: graphql-n-plus-one-p2
prompt: my GraphQL resolver fires a separate database query for every item in a list, how do I stop that

chunks.content: modeled the orders graph so an order exposes its line items and the customer who placed it
added a maximum query depth so a malicious client cannot nest fields and force an enormous resolution tree
made the orders table sticky-header and zebra-striped for readability
shortened refresh token lifetime and added rotation on every use
serve product images from the CDN with a one-day cache header
decided to batch the per-row lookups through a DataLoader so all the author fetches in one list collapse into a single keyed query
the comments resolver now collects every parent id in the page and issues one WHERE id IN (...) select instead of one query per comment
memoize identical entity loads within a single request so the same user row is not fetched twice while resolving one response
turned on the slow query log and found the activity feed doing a full table scan
switched the feed to keyset pagination using the last seen id
for the detail page we eager-join the related rows in one round trip rather than letting each field resolver lazily hit the database
let users switch the UI language from a header dropdown
wrap the payment gateway call in exponential backoff capped at three tries
the health endpoint reports 200 once migrations have applied
sample debug logs at one percent in production to control volume
